posts.cooked:
I also started this thread because from what I’m reading online there was an extra scene after the credits that was not in the UK release, we got the Thantos scene (which was awesome) but not whatever else there is. Can any one confirm there was more?

When I saw it I sat there waiting for an extra scene (having not read the online buzz before going) and was looking out for a scene at the end, hoping against hope that the scene would be Coulson in ‘witness protection’ somewhere. I have lamented in action films where the heroes save everyone but seeing it happen to a character that has survived so many film and become a fan favourite? I am bummed out by it (disappointed he’s dead, not disappointed the film did it).
The fact that he had interacted with all the characters prior to the film except Captain America and then making him a big Cap fan to give Coulson a connection to him too, nice touch and just the push they needed to go Avenging and bond together
